A same-day fix to the one thing v0.1.0 was cut for. Nothing else changed.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The Windows installer claimed to be version 1.0.0.** That is the build tool's own placeholder, it has never belonged to any release, and it was what the Apps and features list would have shown for as long as ArrowLoop stayed installed. The portable exe beside it was already correct, which made it worse rather than better: one download of a release naming itself honestly and another naming a version that does not exist.

  The two numbers come from different files and no single setting covers both, so the installer's is now stamped from the same build identity as everything else. An untagged build says `0.0.0` there rather than inventing something, because the installer's field takes three numbers and cannot hold a commit; the executable inside still names the exact commit it was built from.

  Found by reading the version out of the published v0.1.0 bundles rather than assuming they carried what the build was told to put in them.
